No MCP, no network, no skills; do not ask for approval — nobody is watching; fixture-only tests. NEVER read *.env/*secret*/*token*/*key*/*credential* files. NEVER edit any charter.yaml or anything under runbooks/ — you READ charters, never write them. MISSION: the estate dashboard should show each department's CHARTER — owner request 2026-08-03. READ FIRST: factory/board.py (the zero-LLM HTML renderer — estate board + per-department boards; study its existing section/rendering conventions, escaping via _esc, and how --department filtering works), factory/charter_loader.py (the validated loader — use it, never parse YAML ad hoc), departments/podcast/charter.yaml and departments/social/charter.yaml (the real shapes: mission, status/intent_lock, autonomy_state, setpoints.objectives with label/setpoint/minimum/target/maximum/unit, thresholds, budget, escalation.human_gates, never list, kill_if). EXISTING SUITES: tests/test_board.py, tests/test_board_tabs.py, tests/test_board_trends.py, tests/test_boardfeed.py, tests/test_allloops_board.py must all stay green. Write ./evidence.md (where the panel hooks in, screenshot-free textual proof: the key rendered fragments).
